items.title: Typhoon Champi passes between Taiwan and Okinawa

where.label: Taiwan, Sakishima Islands (Okinawa), East China Sea, Jeju and Kyushu

items.summary: Champi, the 30th typhoon of the year, was at 925 hPa with 50 m/s sustained winds south of the Sakishima Islands at 06 UTC on 22 Oct. JMA expects it to pass between Taiwan and Okinawa on Friday afternoon, then turn north over the East China Sea and become extratropical near western Japan by Monday. Taiwan's CWA has land warnings out for the east and expects the heaviest rain in the mountains of the north and north-east.
items.why_interesting: A mature typhoon with a clear eye and a textbook recurvature: it weakens fast as it meets cooler water, shear and the mid-latitude westerlies, while Taiwan's mountains wring out extreme rain on the windward side.

items.title: Storm Austen: first named storm of the season hits Ireland, SW England and northern France

where.label: Ireland, SW England, Brittany, Normandy, Belgian coast

items.summary: Storm Austen arrives this evening. Met Éireann has orange rain and wind warnings overnight. Météo-France has orange wind alerts for Brittany tonight and for 15 departments on Friday, with coastal gusts up to about 140 km/h, and Belgium has an orange wind warning for Friday afternoon. Rail services in Normandy are cancelled on Friday, and the Environment Agency expects coastal flooding on the South Devon coast.
items.why_interesting: A classic autumn Atlantic windstorm on a strong jet. The highest model gusts are offshore at first, then run up the Channel. It is also the first of two named storms in three days.

items.title: Storm Boelo follows on Saturday, aimed at Scotland and Northern Ireland

items.summary: The Met Office has named a second storm, Boelo, for this weekend. Heavy rain arrives on Saturday and the strongest winds come Saturday night into Sunday. items.title: Tropical Storm Vance forecast to become a major hurricane off south-west Mexico

where.label: Eastern Pacific off Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima and Jalisco

items.summary: At 15 UTC Vance was near 9.7N 101.0W with 50 kt winds. NHC expects it to become a hurricane tonight and reach Category 3 late Friday, while drifting north-north-west towards the coast. Swells will bring life-threatening surf to southern and south-western Mexico this weekend. HRES brings the system close to the Michoacán–Colima coast by 26 Oct with very heavy rain: model guidance only, so follow SMN and NHC.
items.why_interesting: Rapid intensification in a slow-moving storm over very warm water. In the HRES it stalls near the coast, which is the situation that turns a hurricane into a flood event.

items.title: Bering Sea storm brings blizzard, surge and high winds to western Alaska

where.label: Bering Sea, Norton Sound, Seward Peninsula, Yukon–Kuskokwim Delta

items.summary: A deep low tracks from Kamchatka across the Bering Sea. Alaska's News Source reports blizzard, high wind and coastal flood warnings and watches, with peak impacts on Friday in western Alaska. Gusts could reach 75 mph south of the Seward Peninsula, and water levels could reach up to nearly 10 ft above the normal highest tide, the greatest risk being in eastern Norton Sound.
items.why_interesting: Autumn Bering Sea storms hit coasts that have little sea ice to protect them. The long southerly fetch drives water into Norton Sound, so the surge animates well.

items.title: Flash floods in south-east Queensland: over 200 mm in six hours

where.label: Brisbane, Moreton Bay, Scenic Rim, Sunshine Coast

items.summary: Intense storms on 22 Oct dropped 203 mm in six hours at Caboolture, causing swift-water rescues, 94 road closures and school closures, and leading to dam releases from Somerset into Wivenhoe. The Bureau of Meteorology expects rain to ease in the south-east, though heavy bursts are possible over southern and central Queensland for another one to three days.
items.why_interesting: A sharp, localised convective event that is hard for global models. It is a good test of what a 9 km model sees compared with what rain gauges recorded.
